proposals.before: The house of Zhou received its sign when a white fish leaped into King Wu's boat, and he offered it to Heaven in a burnt sacrifice.
proposals.after: The house of Zhou received its sign when a fish leaped into the boat, and marked it as auspicious with a burnt offering.
proposals.reason: Chinese names only Zhou (周) and a fish falling into a boat (躍魚隕杭); idiomatic invents King Wu and that the fish was white.

proposals.before: From me heaven covers, clouds oily-oily.
proposals.after: From our Heaven covering us, the clouds roll thickly.
proposals.reason: Literal “From me heaven covers, clouds oily-oily” is unintelligible and mistranslates 自我天覆 / 油油.

proposals.before: Tang and Wu held the highest rank yet never dropped their awe; Shun, though enthroned by borrowed forms, still reviewed his faults. This is the sense of it.
proposals.after: Tang and Wu held the highest rank yet never dropped their awe; Shun, while dwelling in the great canons, still reviewed his faults. This is the sense of it.
proposals.reason: 假典 means the great canons/statutes (假 as 'great'), not 'borrowed forms'.

proposals.before: Therefore Tang and Wu, though supremely honored, did not lose reverent awe; Shun, dwelling in borrowed ritual texts, looked back and examined his oversights: this is what is meant.
proposals.after: Therefore Tang and Wu, though supremely honored, did not lose reverent awe; Shun, dwelling in the great canons, looked back and examined his oversights: this is what is meant.
proposals.reason: 假典 is 'great canons', not 'borrowed ritual texts'.

proposals.before: Eight years later he worshiped the central peak, performed the feng on Mount Tai, went on to Liangfu, and the shan at Suyan.
proposals.after: Eight years after Xiangru's death he worshiped the central peak, performed the feng on Mount Tai, went on to Liangfu, and the shan at Suyan.
proposals.reason: 八年 counts from Xiangru's death (parallel to 既卒五歲), not from the Hou Tu sacrifice eight years later.

decisions.reason: s0207 has only 周躍魚隕杭，休之以燎: Zhou, a fish leaping into the boat, and an auspicious burnt offering. It never names 武王 or calls the fish 白, so those details are invented English.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 蓋周躍魚隕杭，休之以燎

decisions.after: Since Heaven covers us, the clouds roll thickly.
decisions.reason: The before gloss is unintelligible: 油油 describes thickly rolling clouds, not oil, and 自我天覆 is Heaven covering us. The proposal fixes that sense but “From our Heaven covering us” awkwardly attaches 我 to Heaven; “Since Heaven covers us” tracks the Chinese cleanly.
In 舜在假典, 假 is the classical “great” reading and 典 the canons/statutes; “enthroned by borrowed forms” invents a borrowing sense not supported by the phrase.
The same 假典 in s0256 is “great canons,” not “borrowed ritual texts”; the proposed literal restores that sense without other changes.
s0257 sets the clock with 相如既卒五歲; s0258’s 八年而遂 continues from that death, not from the Hou Tu rite. “Eight years later” after s0257 wrongly suggests eight years after the sacrifice.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0001 shows s0207 never prints 武王; the King Wu title claim exists only because the bad idiomatic invented him.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 蓋周躍魚隕杭，休之以燎

claimRetractions.reason: The ruler role for King Wu at s0207 depends solely on the invented English naming; the Chinese unit names only 周.
Sex for King Wu was inferred only after the bad idiomatic placed him in s0207; the Chinese does not name him.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 蓋周躍魚隕杭，休之以燎

claimRetractions.reason: The BC 1046 King Wu attestation is keyed to identifying the omen agent as King Wu, which s0207’s Chinese never states.
